title: The absorber files the same defect again and again: one SIGTERM temp-tree failure became five backlog ticks
description:
zv1, mtq, 0wp, 1zw and bsn were filed by five workers over 2.5 hours for one failure of TestSIGTERMToALiveRunEvacuatesItsWorkToTheRemote; a promoted finding leaves the drafts workers see, and nothing checks open ticks the run itself promoted. 8d6 (4230b469) fixed it and the test passes 3/3 at the tip, so the five can close as fixed. Deduplicate a new finding against open ticks the run promoted (same demonstrating_check or test name) before filing.

ticfac run epic-2jn filed this backlog tick from the finding f9268a329bb551f30336c0c17b8be5fb118867af54565490d6764e6db5cb74d2 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-rrl/attempt-54): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/f9268a329bb551f30336c0c17b8be5fb118867af54565490d6764e6db5cb74d2.json on the run branch.
notes: 2026-09-27 22:47 - ticfac run epic-2jn: created by absorbing finding f9268a329bb551f30336c0c17b8be5fb118867af54565490d6764e6db5cb74d2 — a backlog tick: the done is reachable with the finding standing. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/f9268a329bb551f30336c0c17b8be5fb118867af54565490d6764e6db5cb74d2.json on epic/2jn, and it says: no classifier prediction could be made — no classifier is configured for gating predictions — so the reporter's own claim decides: it breaks no done item, and the finding is filed to the backlog rather than absorbed. The claim is a prediction, scored later against what the done actually did
